specs.Connector Type: USB Type A, USB Type C

features: Portronics Adapto 45: 22.5W Mach USB & Type-C Dual Output Super Fast Charger, Wall Adapter with Power Delivery 3.0 Fast Charging & USB A Fast Charge Adaptor for iPhone, Android & Other Type C Enabled Devices.

GaN Technology: Built using advanced GaN (Gallium Nitride) tech, offering a smaller, cooler, and more energy-efficient charge compared to conventional silicon chargers - without compromising on power or speed.
22.5W Fast Charging Adapter: Two ports deliver up to 22.5W combined output. When charging multiple devices, the Mach USB-A port splits power between 10W Mach charging and 10W PD fast charging.
PD 3.0 & Mach: Equipped with a 22.5W Power Delivery 3.0 port and a Mach USB-A port, this charger allows two devices to be charged simultaneously.

Safe & Reliable: Mach-certified & PD 3.0 charger with a built-in intelligent chip that auto-matches current to your device's needs, ensuring safety and protection. A combination of 6 safety features works together to protect you and your devices.
